threat_model.threat_source: AI systems; AI-driven governance; AI decision-making processes; intricate web of AI systems actually implementing policy
threat_model.objective_or_harmful_outcome: Democratic processes might persist formally but become less meaningful; The complexity of AI-driven governance might make it increasingly difficult for human citizens to understand or critique government decisions; Traditional forms of civic engagement — from public consultations to protests — might become less effective; The bureaucracy itself might become increasingly opaque to human oversight; AI decision-making processes might be too complex for meaningful human review; they might struggle to exercise real control over the intricate web of AI systems actually implementing policy
threat_model.capability: much of the implementation of the law might come from AI systems; AI decision-making processes; AI systems actually implementing policy
threat_model.access: look to AI systems for advice on what legislation to pass, how to actually write the legislation, and what the law even is; much of the implementation of the law might come from AI systems; AI systems actually implementing policy
threat_model.constraints_or_enabling_conditions: Democratic processes might persist formally; humans would nominally maintain sovereignty; oversight boards and democratic institutions remain in place; AI decision-making processes might be too complex for meaningful human review; if such review happens, it may depend on yet more AI-driven cognition; the state grows less dependent on human cooperation and more capable of predicting and preempting resistance
threat_model.target_or_asset_at_risk: Democratic processes; human citizens; government decisions; Traditional forms of civic engagement — from public consultations to protests; bureaucracy itself; human oversight; meaningful human review; oversight boards and democratic institutions; real control
